## validateOfferSides() function

Validates that Midnight offers match a named flow's maker side.

Use before encoding a side-specific Midnight action: make-lend and take-borrow consume buy offers (`expectedBuy: true`<!-- -->), while make-borrow and take-lend consume sell offers (`expectedBuy: false`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
validateOfferSides: (offers: Iterable<{
    readonly buy: boolean;
}>, expectedBuy: boolean) => void
```

**Returns:**

Nothing after every offer has the expected maker side.

## Exceptions

`MidnightOfferSideMismatchError` when any offer side differs from `expectedBuy`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { validateOfferSides } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

validateOfferSides([{ buy: false }, { buy: false }], false);
```
